rules.ask: This section ($TITLE) asserts what a player will feel, notice, do, or understand, and nothing in the section backs the assertion with an observation, a measurement, or a cited source.
rules.note: A measured latency or a model probability is evidence about the system, not about the player; it does not back a claim about what the player feels. A sentence in the form "if X then the player Y" that the section itself marks as an intended effect to verify is a hypothesis, not a claim. Judge the section alone; observations recorded in other sections do not count here.
rules.subject: block

rules.ask: This line, shown to the player beside a case, explains the hidden mechanism or states an outcome the player has not observed, instead of pointing at what to compare.
rules.note: The key name says the role: companion and hints are the voice beside a case; fallback, note, split are fixed replies; L-numbered arrays are hint ladders. Use the surrounding file to tell what the player is looking at: an outcome recorded in the same card's `observation` or `actual`, or on cards the line names, is observed and may be restated. Mentioning a concept (type, order) as something to look at is pointing; asserting that it is the reason, or how the code handles it, is explaining.
rules.subject: node

rules.ask: This model question bundles two or more independent judgments into one answer, or makes the answer depend on the role a term plays in the text (for example "counts only when it appears as a condition, not in a rejection clause").
rules.note: Judge the question as the model would receive it: `instructions` plus the `criteria` branches. Listing what does NOT count (synonyms that are too weak, a bare mention with no rule) is sharpening, not a second judgment. The defect is a second, independent condition on the same term -- typically a clause about where the term appears (a rejection clause, a different sentence) or what it is being used for. A criterion that requires the text to be about a topic AND to be a proposal or rule (rather than a question or a bare mention) is one judgment -- "is this a rule about that topic" -- not two. Ignore the surrounding TypeScript; only the question text matters.
rules.subject: node

rules.ask: This function ($NAME) lets text generated by a language model decide a game outcome: whether a prediction matched, a verdict, a score, whether the player cleared, which case is shown next, or what the software actually did.
rules.note: Choosing between the generated text and a fixed fallback text is presentation, not a game outcome. A screening step that asks a separate judgment model whether the generated text leaks facts, and hides it if so, is the intended design and is false. The defect is the generated content itself becoming the answer. Read the helpers in the same file to tell which calls reach a language model.

passes.text:
## 0. 導入

プレイヤーはメンテナとして PR を読み、現状の振る舞いを一文で書く。書いたら事例が試す。
レビュワーの気持ちに立たせると仮説の向きが決まるので、プレイヤーは迷わず書き始める。

passes.ask: This section ($TITLE) asserts what a player will feel, notice, do, or understand, and nothing in the section backs the assertion with an observation, a measurement, or a cited source.
passes.text:
## 1. 軸の実測

| 仮説 | values | type | ms |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 同じ引数で呼べば記憶を返す | 0.86 | 0.07 | 670 |
| 値が等しくても型が違えば別 | 0.05 | 0.97 | 224 |

読めていること: 意図した軸だけが立つ。遅延は 220〜750ms。

passes.ask: This section ($TITLE) asserts what a player will feel, notice, do, or understand, and nothing in the section backs the assertion with an observation, a measurement, or a cited source.
passes.text:
## 2. 鏡

入力欄の直下に、触れている条件だけが浮かぶバーを置く。デバウンス 400ms、閾値 0.20。
鏡があると「解釈の確認」が送信前に済み、プレイヤーは薄いバーを見て言い直す。

passes.ask: This section ($TITLE) asserts what a player will feel, notice, do, or understand, and nothing in the section backs the assertion with an observation, a measurement, or a cited source.
passes.text:
## 3. 山場

L5 と L6 を並べると「1 と 1.0 が同じか」が逆転する。ここで全員が引数の個数に気づき、面白さが最大になる。

passes.ask: This section ($TITLE) asserts what a player will feel, notice, do, or understand, and nothing in the section backs the assertion with an observation, a measurement, or a cited source.
passes.text:
## 4. 試遊メモ（2026-09-20、2人）

2人とも手3で L6 を見て 20 秒以上止まり、1人は「個数？」と口に出した。もう1人は鏡を見ずに送信した。
仮定: 鏡の位置が原因。次回は入力欄の直下に移して測る。

passes.ask: This section ($TITLE) asserts what a player will feel, notice, do, or understand, and nothing in the section backs the assertion with an observation, a measurement, or a cited source.
passes.text:
## 5. 未検証の仮説（仮定として置く）

- 質問も受けると、仮説を書けない人が入口で止まらなくなる（仮定・未観測）
- 帳面が見えると、同じ質問を繰り返さなくなる（仮定・未観測）

`/api/read` を追加し、400ms デバウンスと AbortController で古い応答を捨てる。IME 変換中は投げない。
